children: The USDA has once again confirmed a new flash sale of U.S. soybean exports to China. The USDA says that 202,000 metric tons of soybeans were sold to China for delivery in the 2026/27 marketing year. That's on top of 136,000 tons reported sold to China on Tuesday, building momentum for trader hopes of strong export sales demand for U.S. crops. CBOT soybean futures are down 1.3% in morning trade, with the most-active contract backing down after passing the $13 a bushel mark for the first time since December 2023 yesterday. Profit-taking is likely driving the downturn seen this morning, says Joe Davis of Futures International in a note. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
